FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: USD/JPY near 158 with bullish fundamentals despite overbought RSI.
MA20 at 156.27 offers immediate support; break above 158.50 needed.
Oil price cuts and softer Fed expectations support USD strength.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds near 158 as USD strengthens, RSI overbought but fundamentals bullish; target MA20 support.
FX.comment: USD/JPY holds near 158 as USD strengthens, RSI overbought but fundamentals bullish; target MA20 support.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: S&P 500 exhibits strong resilience despite external headwinds, holding above key moving averages.
Soft labor data shifts Fed policy expectations, providing a strong fundamental tailwind for equities.
Technical indicators show neutral-to-bullish momentum with RSI at 59.44, leaving room for further upside.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 remains highly bullish as soft jobs data eases Fed hike bets and technicals hold firm above MA20 support level.
STOCKS.comment: S&P 500 is in a healthy uptrend with strong support at MA20 and bullish momentum driven by soft labor data.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] UP: Price Holds Above MA20, Jobs Data Weak, ECB On‑Chain Plans Boost Outlook
tldr_points: Price holds above MA20 (~82.8k) with RSI near 69, signalling bullish momentum.
Weak US jobs data and ECB’s exploration of on‑chain central bank money provide macro tailwinds.
Key resistance at $88k; support at $82.5k (MA20) defines a favorable risk/reward setup.
